slides.text: **Eritrea** asks **UN officials** to pressure Ethiopia over the Red Sea; Ethiopia's PM says it **will not invade**, Ethiopia Observer reports.
AFP reports displaced Tigrayans fear **never returning** to **western Tigray**; residents' abuse allegations are **not independently verified**.
Kenyans.co.ke reports **over 300 stranded Kenyan trucks** began heading home from Ethiopia on **Nov 26**, under **Ethiopian military escort**.

slides.title: Back tomorrow at 11 PM.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Sources: Eritrea Information Ministry, Ethiopia Observer, AFP/Arab News, Kenyans.co.ke (Nov 26–27, 2026)
